title: Demolition
previewText: The Department of Buildings shall not issue a permit for the demolition of a multiple dwelling, as defined in Section 93-90 (HARASSMENT), paragraph (a)(14), located within Subareas D4 or D5 in the Hell’s Kitchen Subdistrict D or within Subdistrict H of the Special Hudson Yards District, or an alteration permit for the partial demolition of a multiple dwelling located within Subareas D4 and D5 or within Subdistrict H

subsections.plainText: (b) the Commissioner of the Department of Housing Preservation and Development, after providing 60 days notice and opportunity to comment to the local Community Board, has certified:
